facts.fact: ARCT's 2020 ICT indicators report (July 2021) states Burundi has access to submarine cables (EASSy, SEACOM, TEAMS) via partners and cable operators in neighbouring countries, and lists cross-border fibre connection points with Rwanda (Gasenyi, Kanyaru Haut), the DRC (Ruhwa, Gatumba) and Tanzania (Kobero, Mugina/Manyovu); no per-route traffic or in-service dates are given, and no date is stated beyond the report's own (published 2021-07).
facts.system: EASSy, SEACOM, TEAMS via Rwanda, DRC and Tanzania connection points

note: Cables are reached through neighbours, none lands in Burundi; no access (open/none) statement; international bandwidth in Gbit is listed as an indicator but no figure is given.
